# PhysiqueHub

> PhysiqueHub is a Korean-language competition schedule hub for bodybuilding and fitness athletes. It helps users discover upcoming contests by date, region, organization, division, and competition type.

PhysiqueHub focuses on public competition discovery, not athlete coaching, diet, training, or medical advice. Competition dates, venues, divisions, registration windows, natural/testing status, and pro-card routes can change by season and organizer. Treat official organizer or federation links on each competition detail page as the final source of truth.

The canonical site is `https://physiquehub.kr`. Public pages are written primarily in Korean for Korean search users.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://physiquehub.kr): Current season overview and curated upcoming competition sections.
- [Competition list](https://physiquehub.kr/competitions): Upcoming bodybuilding and fitness competitions with filters for organization, region, category, registration status, and type.
- [Guide](https://physiquehub.kr/guide): Introductory guidance for first-time competitors, divisions, and organizations.
- [About](https://physiquehub.kr/about): Service purpose and scope.

## Competition Discovery Pages

- [Bodybuilding competitions](https://physiquehub.kr/competitions/categories/bodybuilding): Upcoming bodybuilding contests.
- [Classic physique competitions](https://physiquehub.kr/competitions/categories/classic-physique): Upcoming classic physique contests.
- [Men's physique competitions](https://physiquehub.kr/competitions/categories/mens-physique): Upcoming men's physique contests.
- [Bikini competitions](https://physiquehub.kr/competitions/categories/bikini): Upcoming bikini contests.
- [Natural competitions](https://physiquehub.kr/competitions/types/natural): Upcoming competitions tagged as natural or tested where supported by source data.
- [Rookie competitions](https://physiquehub.kr/competitions/types/rookie): Upcoming beginner-friendly or rookie-class competitions.
- [IFBB and NPC competitions](https://physiquehub.kr/competitions/organizations/ifbb): IFBB Pro League, NPC Worldwide, and related Korean schedule pages.
- [KBBF competitions](https://physiquehub.kr/competitions/organizations/kbbf): Korea Bodybuilding Federation schedule pages.
- [NABBA competitions](https://physiquehub.kr/competitions/organizations/nabba): NABBA Korea schedule pages.
- [PCA competitions](https://physiquehub.kr/competitions/organizations/pca): PCA and NPCA Korea schedule pages.

## Machine-Readable Discovery

- [XML sitemap](https://physiquehub.kr/sitemap.xml): Canonical indexable URLs for public discovery.
- [robots.txt](https://physiquehub.kr/robots.txt): Crawler access policy.

## Source And Accuracy Notes

- PhysiqueHub prefers official organizer, federation, registration, or board pages over aggregators.
- Aggregator data may be used for discovery or review, but should not be treated as official truth.
- Event detail pages may include structured data and source links when available.
- Past competition detail pages may remain accessible for users but are not the primary indexing target.
